rationale: The 8.8 guide preserves the 30-day Essentials and 90-day Premier trial terms. In a Cloud Connected Premier trial, Splunk Cloud Services does not recognize the trial entitlement, so the UI shows Essentials even while Cloud Connected features continue functioning during the trial. The baseline licensing report omitted that display qualification. The candidate adds it to the existing licensing detail and keeps contract entitlement, compatibility, and authorization separate.

exclusions: Individual contract entitlement, native SOAR pairing, service authorization, and broader feature access remain separate.
